paragraphsHtml: Brickell and Downtown pack restaurants, bars and food halls into a few walkable blocks. Your competition is the rooftop across the street and the new opening down the block, all on the same phone screen.
Weekdays bring the office lunch rush, then an after-work crowd deciding on the fly. Evenings and weekends belong to condo residents, hotel guests and visitors, many of them more at home in Spanish.

proof.h2: Ads proof from across the causeway
proof.bodyHtml: A 7:1 return means every $1 of ads brought back about $7 in conversion value tracked by Google, $135K across the year. Mother's Day alone brought 155 conversions at $3.06 each.

steps.h2: What we'd do first in Brickell and Downtown

items.title: Pick the shift you want to own
items.bodyHtml: Weekday lunch or happy hour, chosen on purpose. Then the right Google update, post and ad go out at the right hour, instead of a generic feed.

items.title: Win the five-minute decision
items.bodyHtml: People here choose minutes before they walk in. We tune your Google listing, photos and reviews, and put booking one tap away on a fast, mobile-first website.

items.title: Aim ads a few blocks out
items.bodyHtml: Google and Meta ads aimed at the towers around you, on the days and hours that matter, with every call and booking tracked. Same work as Rusty Pelican's 7:1.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Brickell and Downtown Miami?
faqs.a: Yes. We are a Miami agency, and our work for Shimuja Ramen at Julia & Henry's on Flagler St is one of our case studies.

faqs.q: Can you fill a slow weekday lunch or happy hour?
faqs.a: Yes. We line up Google updates, posts and targeted ads for the hours you want to fill, then track the calls, bookings and orders that come in.

faqs.q: Do you run Google Ads for restaurants?
faqs.a: Yes. For Rusty Pelican Miami on Key Biscayne, our 2025 Google Ads work returned about $7 in conversion value for every $1 spent, across 1,007 conversions.

faqs.q: Do you create content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team is bilingual, so posts, ads, menus and review replies can run in English, Spanish or both.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Brickell or Downtown restaurant
cta.body: Tell us which shifts you want fuller (lunch, happy hour or weekend nights) and we will show you where we would start. Free, in English or Spanish.
